```{=html}
    const displacementH = elongationED + (elongationFC - elongationED) * platformHLocation / platformUpperSpan;
    const displacementA = displacementH + elongationAH;
    const displacementB = elongationFC + elongationBC;
    const loadDisplacement = displacementA + (displacementB - displacementA) * platformLoadLocation / platformLowerSpan;
    const thetaAB = (displacementB - displacementA) / lowerSpanIn;
    const thetaDC = (elongationFC - elongationED) / upperSpanIn;
    const forceEntries = [["AH", forceAH], ["BC", forceBC], ["ED", forceED], ["FC", forceFC]];
    const elongationEntries = [["AH", elongationAH], ["BC", elongationBC], ["ED", elongationED], ["FC", elongationFC]];
    const governingForce = forceEntries.sort((left, right) => right[1] - left[1])[0];
    const governingElongation = elongationEntries.sort((left, right) => right[1] - left[1])[0];
    values.platform_x_HC_ft = formatDerived(platformUpperSpan - platformHLocation, 2);
    values.platform_T_AH_lb = formatDerived(forceAH, 1);
    values.platform_T_BC_lb = formatDerived(forceBC, 1);
    values.platform_T_ED_lb = formatDerived(forceED, 1);
    values.platform_T_FC_lb = formatDerived(forceFC, 1);
    values.platform_delta_AH_in = formatDerived(elongationAH, 5);
    values.platform_delta_BC_in = formatDerived(elongationBC, 5);
    values.platform_delta_ED_in = formatDerived(elongationED, 5);
    values.platform_delta_FC_in = formatDerived(elongationFC, 5);
    values.platform_delta_H_in = formatDerived(displacementH, 5);
    values.platform_delta_A_in = formatDerived(displacementA, 5);
    values.platform_delta_B_in = formatDerived(displacementB, 5);
    values.platform_delta_load_in = formatDerived(loadDisplacement, 5);
    values.platform_theta_AB_rad = formatDerived(Math.abs(thetaAB), 7);
    values.platform_theta_AB_deg = formatDerived(Math.abs(thetaAB) * 180 / Math.PI, 4);
    values.platform_theta_DC_rad = formatDerived(Math.abs(thetaDC), 8);
    values.platform_theta_DC_deg = formatDerived(Math.abs(thetaDC) * 180 / Math.PI, 5);
    values.platform_lower_tilt_direction = thetaAB < 0 ? "downward toward A" : "downward toward B";
    values.platform_upper_tilt_direction = thetaDC < 0 ? "downward toward D" : "downward toward C";
    values.platform_governing_wire = governingForce[0];
    values.platform_governing_force_lb = formatDerived(governingForce[1], 1);
    values.platform_dominant_wire = governingElongation[0];
    values.platform_dominant_elongation_in = formatDerived(governingElongation[1], 5);
  }

  const cableMass = numericValue(values, "m");
  const cableGravity = numericValue(values, "g");
  const cableThetaAB = numericValue(values, "theta_AB");
  const cableThetaBC = numericValue(values, "theta_BC");
  const cableSigmaFail = numericValue(values, "sigma_fail");
  const cableFosReq = numericValue(values, "FOS_req");
  const cableDAB = numericValue(values, "d_AB");
  const cableDBC = numericValue(values, "d_BC");

  if (
    Number.isFinite(cableMass) &&
    Number.isFinite(cableGravity) &&
    Number.isFinite(cableThetaAB) &&
    Number.isFinite(cableThetaBC)

    const thetaABRad = cableThetaAB * Math.PI / 180;
    const thetaBCRad = cableThetaBC * Math.PI / 180;
    const sinAB = Math.sin(thetaABRad);
    const cosAB = Math.cos(thetaABRad);
    const sinBC = Math.sin(thetaBCRad);
    const cosBC = Math.cos(thetaBCRad);
    const denominator = sinAB + cosAB * sinBC / cosBC;
    if (cosBC > 0 && denominator > 0) {
      const weight = cableMass * cableGravity;
      const tensionAB = weight / denominator;
      const tensionBC = tensionAB * cosAB / cosBC;

      values.cable_T_BC_N = formatDerived(tensionBC, 1);
      values.cable_T_AB_kN = formatDerived(tensionAB / 1000, 3);
      values.cable_T_BC_kN = formatDerived(tensionBC / 1000, 3);
      values.cable_governing_tension_member = tensionAB >= tensionBC ? "AB" : "BC";

      if (Number.isFinite(cableSigmaFail) && cableSigmaFail > 0 && Number.isFinite(cableFosReq) && cableFosReq > 0) {
        const allowable = cableSigmaFail / cableFosReq;

        const areaReqBC = tensionBC / allowable;

        values.cable_A_AB_req_mm2 = formatDerived(areaReqAB, 3);
        values.cable_A_BC_req_mm2 = formatDerived(areaReqBC, 3);
        values.cable_d_AB_min_mm = formatDerived(Math.sqrt(4 * areaReqAB / Math.PI), 3);
        values.cable_d_BC_min_mm = formatDerived(Math.sqrt(4 * areaReqBC / Math.PI), 3);

        const stressBC = tensionBC / areaBC;
        values.cable_A_AB_mm2 = formatDerived(areaAB, 3);
        values.cable_A_BC_mm2 = formatDerived(areaBC, 3);

        values.cable_sigma_BC_MPa = formatDerived(stressBC, 1);

          values.cable_governing_fos = formatDerived(governingFos, 2);
          values.cable_design_recommendation = Number.isFinite(cableFosReq) && governingFos >= cableFosReq

        }
      }

  const seatLoad = numericValue(values, "seat_P");
  const seatOffset = numericValue(values, "seat_x");
  const seatOuterWidth = numericValue(values, "seat_B");
  const seatOuterHeight = numericValue(values, "seat_H");
  const seatInnerWidth = numericValue(values, "seat_b");
  const seatInnerHeight = numericValue(values, "seat_h");

  if (

    Number.isFinite(seatOuterWidth) && seatOuterWidth > 0 &&

    const maximumStress = moment / sectionModulus;
    values.seat_V_lb = formatDerived(seatLoad, 1);
    values.seat_M_lbin = formatDerived(moment, 1);
    values.seat_area_in2 = formatDerived(area, 4);
    values.seat_I_in4 = formatDerived(inertia, 4);
    values.seat_c_in = formatDerived(extremeFiber, 3);
    values.seat_S_in3 = formatDerived(sectionModulus, 4);
    values.seat_sigma_max_psi = formatDerived(maximumStress, 1);
    values.seat_sigma_max_ksi = formatDerived(maximumStress / 1000, 3);
    values.seat_tension_fiber = "upper outer fiber";
    values.seat_compression_fiber = "lower outer fiber";
    values.seat_assessment = `The simplified static bending-stress magnitude is ${formatDerived(maximumStress / 1000, 3)} ksi. Compare this value with the specified allowable normal stress, or compute FOS = sigma_allow/|sigma_max|. If the criterion is not met, increase effective section depth or wall thickness, reduce the load offset, reduce the design load, or select an appropriate stronger section and material.`;

  const hangerAllowableStress = numericValue(values, "hanger_sigma_allow");
  const hangerOffset = numericValue(values, "hanger_L");
  const hangerRadius = numericValue(values, "hanger_R");
  const hangerTopWidth = numericValue(values, "hanger_B");
  const hangerHeight = numericValue(values, "hanger_H");
  const hangerWebThickness = numericValue(values, "hanger_t1");
  const hangerFlangeThickness = numericValue(values, "hanger_t2");

  if (
    Number.isFinite(hangerAllowableStress) && hangerAllowableStress > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerOffset) && hangerOffset > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerRadius) && hangerRadius > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerTopWidth) && hangerTopWidth > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerHeight) && hangerHeight > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerWebThickness) && hangerWebThickness > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(hangerFlangeThickness) && hangerFlangeThickness > 0 &&

    const webArea = hangerWebThickness * webHeight;
    const topArea = hangerTopWidth * hangerFlangeThickness;
    const totalArea = bottomArea + webArea + topArea;
    const bottomY = hangerFlangeThickness / 2;

    values.hanger_M_Nmm = formatDerived(allowableMoment, 1);
    values.hanger_A_top_mm2 = formatDerived(topArea, 1);
    values.hanger_A_web_mm2 = formatDerived(webArea, 1);
    values.hanger_A_bottom_mm2 = formatDerived(bottomArea, 1);
    values.hanger_A_total_mm2 = formatDerived(totalArea, 1);
    values.hanger_ybar_mm = formatDerived(centroid, 3);
    values.hanger_I_mm4 = formatDerived(inertia, 1);
    values.hanger_c_top_mm = formatDerived(topFiber, 3);
    values.hanger_c_bottom_mm = formatDerived(bottomFiber, 3);
    values.hanger_c_crit_mm = formatDerived(criticalFiber, 3);
    values.hanger_governing_fiber = bottomFiber >= topFiber ? "bottom extreme fiber" : "top extreme fiber";
    values.hanger_S_mm3 = formatDerived(sectionModulus, 1);
    values.hanger_Pmax_N = formatDerived(allowableLoad, 1);
    values.hanger_Pmax_kN = formatDerived(allowableLoad / 1000, 3);
    values.hanger_sigma_top_MPa = formatDerived(topStress, 1);
    values.hanger_sigma_bottom_MPa = formatDerived(bottomStress, 1);
    values.hanger_tension_fiber = "top extreme fiber";
    values.hanger_compression_fiber = "bottom extreme fiber";
    values.hanger_assessment = `Under the stated static straight-beam model, limit the suspended load to ${formatDerived(allowableLoad / 1000, 3)} kN so the governing ${values.hanger_governing_fiber} does not exceed ${formatDerived(hangerAllowableStress, 1)} MPa. If additional capacity is required, increase effective section depth or flange area, move material farther from the neutral axis, or reduce the ${formatDerived(hangerOffset, 1)} mm offset. The ${formatDerived(hangerRadius, 1)} mm bend radius defines the physical geometry but does not replace the perpendicular moment arm in M = PL.`;
  }


  const lineF1 = numericValue(values, "line_F1");
  const lineF2 = numericValue(values, "line_F2");
  const lineF3 = numericValue(values, "line_F3");
  const lineL1 = numericValue(values, "line_L1");
  const lineL2 = numericValue(values, "line_L2");
  const lineL3 = numericValue(values, "line_L3");
  const lineL4 = numericValue(values, "line_L4");

  if (
    Number.isFinite(lineF1) && lineF1 >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineF2) && lineF2 >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineF3) && lineF3 >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineL1) && lineL1 > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineL2) && lineL2 > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineL3) && lineL3 > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(lineL4) && lineL4 > 0
  ) {
    const lineX1 = lineL1;
    const lineX2 = lineL1 + lineL2;
    const lineXB = lineX2 + lineL3;
    const lineX3 = lineXB + lineL4;
    const lineBy = (lineF1 * lineX1 - lineF2 * lineX2 + lineF3 * lineX3) / lineXB;
    const lineAy = lineF1 + lineF3 - lineF2 - lineBy;
    const lineShears = [
      lineAy,
      lineAy - lineF1,
      lineAy - lineF1 + lineF2,
      lineAy - lineF1 + lineF2 + lineBy,
      lineAy - lineF1 + lineF2 + lineBy - lineF3
    ];
    const lineMoments = [
      0,
      lineShears[0] * lineL1 / 1000,
      (lineShears[0] * lineL1 + lineShears[1] * lineL2) / 1000,
      (lineShears[0] * lineL1 + lineShears[1] * lineL2 + lineShears[2] * lineL3) / 1000,
      (lineShears[0] * lineL1 + lineShears[1] * lineL2 + lineShears[2] * lineL3 + lineShears[3] * lineL4) / 1000
    ];
    const lineStations = [
      { name: "bearing A", x: 0, moment: lineMoments[0] },
      { name: "pulley 1", x: lineX1, moment: lineMoments[1] },
      { name: "center pulley 2", x: lineX2, moment: lineMoments[2] },
      { name: "bearing B", x: lineXB, moment: lineMoments[3] },
      { name: "overhung pulley 3", x: lineX3, moment: lineMoments[4] }

    const lineCritical = lineStations.reduce((current, station) =>

    values.line_By_N = formatDerived(Math.abs(lineBy), 2);

    values.line_M1_Nm = formatDerived(lineMoments[1], 2);
    values.line_M2_Nm = formatDerived(lineMoments[2], 2);
    values.line_MB_Nm = formatDerived(lineMoments[3], 2);
    values.line_M3_Nm = formatDerived(lineMoments[4], 2);
    values.line_Mmax_abs_Nm = formatDerived(Math.abs(lineCritical.moment), 2);
    values.line_Mmax_signed_Nm = formatDerived(lineCritical.moment, 2);
    values.line_Mmax_x_mm = formatDerived(lineCritical.x, 1);

Bending demand can be reduced by moving a bearing or pulley to shorten a governing moment arm, or by reducing the associated belt resultant. A complete shaft design must also evaluate torsion, combined stress, fatigue, stress concentrations, bearing reactions in the perpendicular plane, shaft and pulley weight, alignment, and dynamic belt loading.`;

  const actF = numericValue(values, "act_F");
  const actP = numericValue(values, "act_P");
  const actE = numericValue(values, "act_e");
  const actH = numericValue(values, "act_h");
  const actC = numericValue(values, "act_c");
  const actB = numericValue(values, "act_b");
  const actT = numericValue(values, "act_t");

  if (
    Number.isFinite(actF) && actF >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(actP) && actP >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(actE) && actE >= 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(actH) && actH > 0 &&

  ) {
    const actAxialForce = actP;
    const actShearForce = actF;
    const actHorizontalMoment = actF * actH;
    const actVerticalMoment = actP * actC;
    const actMoment = actHorizontalMoment - actVerticalMoment;
    const actArea = actB * actT;
    const actInertia = actT * actB ** 3 / 12;
    const actExtremeFiber = actB / 2;
    const actAxialStress = actAxialForce / actArea;
    const actSignedBendingStress = actMoment * actExtremeFiber / actInertia;
    const actStressA = actAxialStress - actSignedBendingStress;
    const actStressB = actAxialStress + actSignedBendingStress;
    const actMaximumShear = 1.5 * Math.abs(actShearForce) / actArea;

    const actMomentDirection = actMoment > 1e-9 ? "counterclockwise" : actMoment < -1e-9 ? "clockwise" : "with zero net moment";
    const actCriticalIsA = Math.abs(actStressA) >= Math.abs(actStressB);
  const actCriticalPoint = actCriticalIsA ? "Point A" : "Point B";
    const actCriticalStress = actCriticalIsA ? actStressA : actStressB;

    values.act_N_lb = formatDerived(actAxialForce, 1);
    values.act_V_lb = formatDerived(actShearForce, 1);
    values.act_MF_lbin = formatDerived(actHorizontalMoment, 1);
    values.act_MP_lbin = formatDerived(actVerticalMoment, 1);
    values.act_M_lbin = formatDerived(actMoment, 1);
    values.act_M_abs_lbin = formatDerived(Math.abs(actMoment), 1);
    values.act_M_direction = actMomentDirection;
    values.act_area_in2 = formatDerived(actArea, 4);
    values.act_I_in4 = formatDerived(actInertia, 5);
    values.act_x_extreme_in = formatDerived(actExtremeFiber, 3);
    values.act_sigma_N_psi = formatDerived(actAxialStress, 1);
    values.act_sigma_N_ksi = formatDerived(actAxialStress / 1000, 3);
    values.act_sigma_b_psi = formatDerived(Math.abs(actSignedBendingStress), 1);
    values.act_sigma_b_ksi = formatDerived(Math.abs(actSignedBendingStress) / 1000, 3);
    values.act_sigma_A_psi = formatDerived(actStressA, 1);
    values.act_sigma_A_ksi = formatDerived(actStressA / 1000, 3);
    values.act_sigma_A_type = actStressType(actStressA);
    values.act_sigma_B_psi = formatDerived(actStressB, 1);
    values.act_sigma_B_ksi = formatDerived(actStressB / 1000, 3);

    values.act_tau_B_psi = formatDerived(0, 1);
    values.act_tau_max_psi = formatDerived(actMaximumShear, 1);
    values.act_tau_max_ksi = formatDerived(actMaximumShear / 1000, 3);
    values.act_critical_point = actCriticalPoint;
    values.act_critical_stress_ksi = formatDerived(Math.abs(actCriticalStress) / 1000, 3);

Increase section width b in the bending direction to reduce flexure stress efficiently because I_z is proportional to b cubed, or adjust h and c so the absolute net moment |Fh - Pc| is smaller over every required load case. The upper offset e does not enter this lower-segment cut. Final design must also check bend and hole stress concentrations, lower-pin bearing and contact, upper bolt-group forces, connector deformation, fatigue, impact or dynamic loading, material allowables, and manufacturing details.`;
  }

  const beamMass = numericValue(values, "beam_m");
  const beamGravity = numericValue(values, "beam_g");
  const beamTheta = numericValue(values, "beam_theta");
  const beamBC = numericValue(values, "beam_BC");
  const beamX = numericValue(values, "beam_x");
  const beamS = numericValue(values, "beam_s");
  const beamB = numericValue(values, "beam_b");
  const beamT = numericValue(values, "beam_t");
  const beamYA = numericValue(values, "beam_yA");

  if (
    Number.isFinite(beamMass) && beamMass > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamGravity) && beamGravity > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamTheta) && beamTheta > 0 && beamTheta < 90 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamBC) && beamBC > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamX) && beamX > 0 && beamX < beamBC &&
    Number.isFinite(beamS) && beamS >= 0 && beamX + beamS <= beamBC &&
    Number.isFinite(beamB) && beamB > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamT) && beamT > 0 &&
    Number.isFinite(beamYA) && beamYA >= 0 && beamYA <= beamT / 2
  ) {
    const beamThetaRad = beamTheta * Math.PI / 180;
    const beamWeight = beamMass * beamGravity;
    const beamLengthToC = beamBC - beamX;
    const beamWorkerDistance = beamX + beamS;
    const beamWallReaction = beamWeight * beamWorkerDistance * Math.cos(beamThetaRad) /
      (beamBC * Math.sin(beamThetaRad));
    const beamReactionX = beamWallReaction;
    const beamReactionY = beamWeight;
    const beamExternalAlong = beamReactionX * Math.cos(beamThetaRad) +
      beamReactionY * Math.sin(beamThetaRad);
    const beamExternalNormal = -beamReactionX * Math.sin(beamThetaRad) +
      beamReactionY * Math.cos(beamThetaRad);
    const beamAxialForce = -beamExternalAlong;
    const beamShearForce = -beamExternalNormal;
    const beamMoment = beamX * beamExternalNormal;
    const beamArea = beamB * beamT;
    const beamInertia = beamB * beamT ** 3 / 12;
    const beamFirstMoment = beamB / 2 * ((beamT / 2) ** 2 - beamYA ** 2);
    const beamAxialStress = beamAxialForce / beamArea;
    const beamBendingStress = -beamMoment * 1000 * beamYA / beamInertia;
    const beamCombinedStress = beamAxialStress + beamBendingStress;
    const beamShearStress = beamShearForce * beamFirstMoment / (beamInertia * beamB);
    const beamMaximumShear = 1.5 * beamShearForce / beamArea;
    const beamBendingRatio = Math.abs(beamBendingStress) /
      Math.max(Math.abs(beamAxialStress), Number.EPSILON);
    const beamStressType = (stress) => stress > 1e-9 ? "tension" : stress < -1e-9 ? "compression" : "zero normal stress";
    const beamDominantResponse = Math.abs(beamBendingStress) >= Math.max(Math.abs(beamAxialStress), Math.abs(beamShearStress))
      ? "bending normal stress"
      : Math.abs(beamAxialStress) >= Math.abs(beamShearStress) ? "direct axial stress" : "transverse shear stress";

    values.beam_W_N = formatDerived(beamWeight, 1);
    values.beam_L_m = formatDerived(beamLengthToC, 3);
    values.beam_worker_distance_m = formatDerived(beamWorkerDistance, 3);
    values.beam_C_N = formatDerived(Math.abs(beamWallReaction), 1);
    values.beam_C_direction = beamWallReaction >= 0 ? "to the left" : "to the right";
    values.beam_Bx_N = formatDerived(Math.abs(beamReactionX), 1);
    values.beam_Bx_direction = beamReactionX >= 0 ? "to the right" : "to the left";
    values.beam_By_N = formatDerived(Math.abs(beamReactionY), 1);
    values.beam_By_direction = beamReactionY >= 0 ? "upward" : "downward";
    values.beam_N_N = formatDerived(beamAxialForce, 1);
    values.beam_N_type = beamStressType(beamAxialForce);
    values.beam_V_N = formatDerived(beamShearForce, 1);
    values.beam_M_Nm = formatDerived(beamMoment, 2);
    values.beam_area_mm2 = formatDerived(beamArea, 0);
    values.beam_I_mm4 = formatDerived(beamInertia, 0);
    values.beam_QA_mm3 = formatDerived(beamFirstMoment, 0);
    values.beam_sigma_axial_MPa = formatDerived(beamAxialStress, 4);
    values.beam_sigma_bending_MPa = formatDerived(beamBendingStress, 4);
    values.beam_sigma_A_MPa = formatDerived(beamCombinedStress, 4);
    values.beam_sigma_A_type = beamStressType(beamCombinedStress);
    values.beam_tau_A_MPa = formatDerived(beamShearStress, 5);
    values.beam_tau_A_abs_MPa = formatDerived(Math.abs(beamShearStress), 5);
    values.beam_tau_max_MPa = formatDerived(beamMaximumShear, 5);
    values.beam_sigma_y_MPa = formatDerived(0, 1);
    values.beam_bending_ratio = formatDerived(beamBendingRatio, 1);
    values.beam_dominant_response = beamDominantResponse;
    values.beam_assessment = `At point A, ${beamDominantResponse} governs the nominal stress state. The bending contribution is ${formatDerived(beamBendingRatio, 1)} times the direct axial contribution, while the transverse shear magnitude is ${formatDerived(Math.abs(beamShearStress), 5)} MPa. Increasing thickness t is especially effective because I is proportional to t cubed for the shown orientation; reducing the technician's perpendicular moment arm would also reduce bending. This result is not a complete access-system safety determination. Final evaluation must also address local support and connection stresses, member self-weight, lateral stability, technician motion, impact, vibration, fatigue, material allowables, deflection, and applicable workplace-access requirements.`;
  }

  return values;
}

function substitute(template, problem) {
  const values = variableMap(problem);
  return String(template || "").replace(/\{\{([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => {
    if (key.endsWith("_unit")) {
      return unitHtml(values[key]);
    }
    return escapeHtml(values[key] ?? "");
  });
}

function selectedQuestions(problem) {
  return problem.questions.filter((question) => {
    const checkbox = document.querySelector(`[data-question="${question.id}"]`);
    return checkbox ? checkbox.checked : question.selected;
  });
}

const questionSections = [
  { id: "context", title: "Context and Mechanics Reasoning Questions" },
  { id: "transition", title: "Transition to a Mechanics Model" },
  { id: "analysis", title: "Mechanics Analysis Questions" }
];

function questionsBySection(questions, section) {
  return questions.filter((question) => (question.section || "analysis") === section);
}

function questionIsSelected(question) {
  const variant = selectedVariant();
  if (variant && Array.isArray(variant.selectedQuestions)) {
    return variant.selectedQuestions.includes(question.id);
  }
  return question.selected;
}

function renderProblemOptions() {
  problemSelect.innerHTML = problemCatalog
    .map((problem) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(problem.id)}">${escapeHtml(problem.title)}</option>`)
    .join("");
}

function renderVariantOptions() {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  const variants = problem.variants || [];
  variantSelect.innerHTML = [
    `<option value="">Default values and questions</option>`,
    ...variants.map((variant) => `<option value="${escapeHtml(variant.id)}">${escapeHtml(variant.title)}</option>`)
  ].join("");
  variantSelect.disabled = variants.length === 0;
}

function applyInitialProblemFromUrl() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const requestedProblem = params.get("problem") || "";
  const match = problemCatalog.find((problem) => {
    return requestedProblem.includes(problem.slug) || requestedProblem === problem.id;
  });

  if (match) {
    problemSelect.value = match.id;
  }
}

function symbolHtml(symbol) {
  const parts = String(symbol || "").split("_");
  const greek = {
    alpha: "&alpha;",
    beta: "&beta;",
    gamma: "&gamma;",
    theta: "&theta;",
    sigma: "&sigma;",
    tau: "&tau;",
    delta: "&delta;",
    pi: "&pi;"
  };
  const base = greek[parts[0]] || escapeHtml(parts[0]);
  if (parts.length === 1) {
    return base;
  }
  return `${base}<sub>${escapeHtml(parts.slice(1).join(","))}</sub>`;
}

function unitHtml(unit) {
  const normalized = String(unit || "").trim();
  if (!normalized || normalized === "-") {
    return "";
  }
  return escapeHtml(normalized).replace(/\^(-?\d+)/g, "<sup>$1</sup>");
}

function valueWithUnitHtml(value, unit) {
  const renderedUnit = unitHtml(unit);
  return `${escapeHtml(value)}${renderedUnit ? ` ${renderedUnit}` : ""}`;
}

function renderVariableInputs() {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  const variant = selectedVariant();
  const overrides = variant?.variables || {};
  currentValues = {};

  variableInputs.innerHTML = problem.variables.map((variable) => {
    const value = overrides[variable.key] ?? variable.value;
    currentValues[variable.key] = value;
    return `
      <label class="builder-variable">
        <span class="builder-variable-symbol">${symbolHtml(variable.symbol)}</span>
        <span class="builder-variable-label">${escapeHtml(variable.label)}</span>
        <span class="builder-number-row">
          <input
            data-variable="${escapeHtml(variable.key)}"
            type="number"
            value="${escapeHtml(value)}"
            min="${escapeHtml(variable.min ?? "")}"
            max="${escapeHtml(variable.max ?? "")}"
            step="${escapeHtml(variable.step ?? "any")}"
          >
          <span>${unitHtml(variable.unit)}</span>
        </span>
      </label>
    `;
  }).join("");

  variableInputs.querySelectorAll("input").forEach((input) => {
    input.addEventListener("input", () => {
      currentValues[input.dataset.variable] = input.value;
      renderPreview();
    });
  });
}

function renderQuestionList() {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  questionList.innerHTML = problem.questions.map((question) => `
    <label class="question-option">
      <input data-question="${escapeHtml(question.id)}" type="checkbox" ${questionIsSelected(question) ? "checked" : ""}>
      <span>
        <strong>${escapeHtml(question.title)}</strong>
      </span>
    </label>
  `).join("");

  questionList.querySelectorAll("input").forEach((input) => {
    input.addEventListener("change", renderPreview);
  });
}

function variableRows(problem) {
  return problem.variables.map((variable) => {
    const value = currentValues[variable.key] ?? variable.value;
    return `
      <tr>
        <td>${symbolHtml(variable.symbol)}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(variable.label)}</td>
        <td>${valueWithUnitHtml(value, variable.unit)}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join("");
}

function packetImageUrl(problem, image) {
  const source = String(image || "");
  if (!source) {
    return "";
  }
  if (/^(data:|blob:|https?:|\/)/.test(source)) {
    return new URL(source, window.location.href).href;
  }
  if (source.startsWith(`problems/${problem.slug}/`)) {
    return new URL(source, window.location.href).href;
  }
  return new URL(`problems/${problem.slug}/${source}`, window.location.href).href;
}

function embeddedImageSource(problem, image, embeddedImages = {}) {
  const source = packetImageUrl(problem, image);
  return embeddedImages[source] || source;
}

function imagePath(problem, embeddedImages = {}) {
  return embeddedImageSource(problem, problem.image, embeddedImages);
}

function renderIdealizedImage(problem, embeddedImages = {}) {
  if (!problem.idealizedImage) {
    return "";
  }
  const alt = problem.idealizedImageAlt || `${problem.title} instructor reference idealization`;
  return `
      <section>
        <h2>Instructor Reference Idealization and Input Variables</h2>
        <figure>
          <img src="${escapeHtml(embeddedImageSource(problem, problem.idealizedImage, embeddedImages))}" alt="${escapeHtml(alt)}">
        </figure>
      </section>
  `;
}

function renderLearningObjectives(question) {
  if (!Array.isArray(question.learningObjectives) || question.learningObjectives.length === 0) {
    return "";
  }

  return `
    <div class="learning-objectives">
      <h4>Learning Objectives</h4>
      <ul>
        ${question.learningObjectives.map((objective) => `<li>${escapeHtml(objective)}</li>`).join("")}
      </ul>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderInstructorSupport(question, problem) {
  const gradingNotes = question.gradingNotes ? `
    <div class="support-block">
      <h4>Grading Notes</h4>
      ${substitute(question.gradingNotes, problem)}
    </div>
  ` : "";

  const commonMistakes = question.commonMistakes ? `
    <div class="support-block">
      <h4>Common Mistakes</h4>
      ${substitute(question.commonMistakes, problem)}
    </div>
  ` : "";

  return `${renderLearningObjectives(question)}${gradingNotes}${commonMistakes}`;
}

function renderQuestionSection(problem, questions, section, isInstructor, numberById, embeddedImages = {}) {
  const sectionQuestions = questionsBySection(questions, section.id);
  if (sectionQuestions.length === 0) {
    return "";
  }

  return `
      <section class="packet-question-section">
        <h2>${section.title}</h2>
        ${sectionQuestions.map((question) => `
          <section class="generated-question">
            <h3>${numberById.get(question.id)}. ${escapeHtml(question.title)}</h3>
            ${renderQuestionImage(problem, question, embeddedImages)}
            ${substitute(question.student, problem)}
            ${isInstructor ? `
              <div class="answer-block">
                <h4>Representative Instructor Answer</h4>
                ${substitute(question.instructor, problem)}
              </div>
              ${renderInstructorSupport(question, problem)}
            ` : ""}
          </section>
        `).join("")}
      </section>
  `;
}

function questionImagePath(problem, question) {
  return packetImageUrl(problem, question.image);
}

function renderQuestionImage(problem, question, embeddedImages = {}) {
  const src = questionImagePath(problem, question);
  if (!src) {
    return "";
  }
  const alt = question.imageAlt || `${question.title} supporting image`;
  return `
    <figure class="question-image">
      <img src="${escapeHtml(embeddedImages[src] || src)}" alt="${escapeHtml(alt)}">
    </figure>
  `;
}

function renderDocumentBody(type, embeddedImages = {}) {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  const isInstructor = type === "instructor";
  const documentTitle = isInstructor ? problem.instructorDocumentTitle : problem.studentDocumentTitle;
  const questions = selectedQuestions(problem);
  const numberById = new Map(questions.map((question, index) => [question.id, index + 1]));

  return `
    <article class="generated-packet">
      <header>
        <p class="packet-kicker">${escapeHtml(documentTitle)}</p>
        <h1>${escapeHtml(problem.title)}</h1>
        <p>${escapeHtml(problem.summary)}</p>
      </header>

      <figure>
        <img src="${escapeHtml(imagePath(problem, embeddedImages))}" alt="${escapeHtml(problem.title)} problem image">
      </figure>

      <section>
        <h2>Main Problem Statement</h2>
        ${substitute(problem.problemStatement, problem)}
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2>Engineering Design Goal</h2>
        ${substitute(problem.engineeringGoal, problem)}
      </section>

      ${renderQuestionSection(problem, questions, questionSections[0], isInstructor, numberById, embeddedImages)}

      ${renderQuestionSection(problem, questions, questionSections[1], isInstructor, numberById, embeddedImages)}

      ${renderIdealizedImage(problem, embeddedImages)}

      <section>
        <h2>Given Data</h2>
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Symbol</th>
              <th>Quantity</th>
              <th>Value</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${variableRows(problem)}</tbody>
        </table>
      </section>

      ${renderQuestionSection(problem, questions, questionSections[2], isInstructor, numberById, embeddedImages)}
    </article>
  `;
}

function renderPreview() {
  if (problemCatalog.length === 0) {
    packetPreview.innerHTML = `<p>No problem catalog was found. Run <code>node scripts/build-catalog.mjs</code> and render the site again.</p>`;
    statusText.textContent = "No catalog";
    setControlsEnabled(false);
    return;
  }

  packetPreview.innerHTML = renderDocumentBody(activePreview);
  statusText.textContent = "Updated";
  studentPreviewTab.classList.toggle("active", activePreview === "student");
  instructorPreviewTab.classList.toggle("active", activePreview === "instructor");
}

function documentStyles() {
  return `
    body { color: #343a40; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; margin: 2rem auto; max-width: 850px; padding: 0 1rem; }
    h1 { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; }
    h2 { border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 1.8rem; padding-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
    h4 { font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0 0 0.45rem; }
    img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }
    table { border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0.75rem; width: 100%; }
    th, td { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; padding: 0.55rem; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
    th { background: #f8f9fa; }
    .packet-kicker { color: #1f5fb8; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .answer-block { background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #2780e3; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; }
    .learning-objectives, .support-block { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; }
    @media print { body { margin: 0.5in auto; } }
  `;
}

function blobToDataUrl(blob) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Unable to read downloaded image data."));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

function loadBrowserImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Unable to decode an image for export."));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

async function svgBlobToPngDataUrl(blob) {
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  try {
    const image = await loadBrowserImage(objectUrl);
    const width = image.naturalWidth || image.width || 1600;
    const height = image.naturalHeight || image.height || 1000;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    context.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, width, height);
    return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  }
}

async function fetchEmbeddedImage(source) {
  const response = await fetch(source);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Unable to download image (${response.status}): ${source}`);
  }
  const blob = await response.blob();
  const isSvg = blob.type.includes("svg") || new URL(source).pathname.toLowerCase().endsWith(".svg");
  return isSvg ? svgBlobToPngDataUrl(blob) : blobToDataUrl(blob);
}

async function embeddedPacketImages(problem, questions) {
  const sources = [
    packetImageUrl(problem, problem.image),
    packetImageUrl(problem, problem.idealizedImage),
    ...questions.map((question) => questionImagePath(problem, question))
  ].filter(Boolean);
  const uniqueSources = [...new Set(sources)];
  const entries = await Promise.all(uniqueSources.map(async (source) => [
    source,
    await fetchEmbeddedImage(source)
  ]));
  return Object.fromEntries(entries);
}

async function fullHtmlDocument(type) {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  const questions = selectedQuestions(problem);
  const embeddedImages = await embeddedPacketImages(problem, questions);
  const title = type === "instructor" ? problem.instructorDocumentTitle : problem.studentDocumentTitle;

  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>${escapeHtml(title)} - ${escapeHtml(problem.title)}</title>
  <style>${documentStyles()}</style>
</head>
<body>
${renderDocumentBody(type, embeddedImages)}
</body>
</html>`;
}

async function downloadDoc(type) {
  const problem = selectedProblem();
  statusText.textContent = "Embedding packet images";
  try {
    const html = await fullHtmlDocument(type);
    const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff", html], { type: "application/msword" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${problem.slug}-${type === "instructor" ? "instructor-answers" : "student-homework-questions"}.doc`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    statusText.textContent = `${type === "instructor" ? "Instructor" : "Student"} DOC downloaded`;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    statusText.textContent = "Image export failed";
  }
}

async function waitForDocumentImages(targetDocument) {
  const pendingImages = [...targetDocument.images].map((image) => {
    if (image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0) {
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      image.addEventListener("load", resolve, { once: true });
      image.addEventListener("error", () => reject(new Error("An embedded image failed to load before printing.")), { once: true });
    });
  });
  await Promise.all(pendingImages);
  if (targetDocument.fonts?.ready) {
    await targetDocument.fonts.ready;
  }
}

async function printDocument(type) {
  const newWindow = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!newWindow) {
    statusText.textContent = "Popup blocked";
    return;
  }
  statusText.textContent = "Preparing images for PDF";
  try {
    const html = await fullHtmlDocument(type);
    newWindow.document.open();
    newWindow.document.write(html);
    newWindow.document.close();
    await waitForDocumentImages(newWindow.document);
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      newWindow.requestAnimationFrame(() => newWindow.requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
    });
    newWindow.focus();
    newWindow.print();
    statusText.textContent = `${type === "instructor" ? "Instructor" : "Student"} print opened`;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    newWindow.close();
    statusText.textContent = "Image export failed";
  }
}

function initializeBuilder() {
  if (problemCatalog.length === 0) {
    renderPreview();
    return;
  }

  setControlsEnabled(true);
  renderProblemOptions();
  applyInitialProblemFromUrl();
  renderVariantOptions();
  renderVariableInputs();
  renderQuestionList();
  renderPreview();
}

problemSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
  renderVariantOptions();
  renderVariableInputs();
  renderQuestionList();
  renderPreview();
});

variantSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
  renderVariableInputs();
  renderQuestionList();
  renderPreview();
});

studentPreviewTab.addEventListener("click", () => {
  activePreview = "student";
  renderPreview();
});

instructorPreviewTab.addEventListener("click", () => {
  activePreview = "instructor";
  renderPreview();
});

document.getElementById("download-student-doc").addEventListener("click", () => downloadDoc("student"));
document.getElementById("download-instructor-doc").addEventListener("click", () => downloadDoc("instructor"));
document.getElementById("print-student-pdf").addEventListener("click", () => printDocument("student"));
document.getElementById("print-instructor-pdf").addEventListener("click", () => printDocument("instructor"));

initializeBuilder();
</script>
```
